title: Balancing by counting atoms
caption: H₂ + O₂ → H₂O leaves an oxygen atom unaccounted for. Putting 2 in front of H₂O balances oxygen, and 2 in front of H₂ then balances hydrogen: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O. Only the numbers in front change, never the formulae.
alt: Before: two hydrogen molecules and one oxygen molecule. After: two water molecules.
description: Left side: 2H₂ and O₂, so 4 hydrogen and 2 oxygen atoms.
Right side: 2H₂O, 4 hydrogen and 2 oxygen atoms. Balanced.
